name: Moltron MCP Guard
description: Stands in between OpenClaw and real MCP servers so a credential never has to sit in mcp.servers.<name>.env/.headers in plaintext. Resolves each configured server's credential from OpenClaw's own protected secret store and injects it only on the way out — never into OpenClaw's own config, process environment, or any CLI/status output. Covers both network-based MCP servers (a relay) and locally-run-program ones (a supervised child process). Workaround for openclaw#76493 (mcp.servers.*.headers/env reject SecretRef objects); does not use registerMcpServerConnectionResolver, which is unconditionally requester-scoped and never fires for cron/subagent/heartbeat/public-gateway turns.

servers.description: One entry per MCP server this plugin protects. The key is the server name (matches the mcp.servers.<name> entry this is standing in for).

kind.description: "network": the real server is reached over HTTP(S). "local-program": OpenClaw would otherwise spawn the real program directly.

secret.description: The credential to inject. Set this to a SecretRef object ({source, provider, id}) pointing at a protected entry in OpenClaw's own secret store — never a literal value.

port.description: network only: fixed local port this server's relay listens on (127.0.0.1). Point mcp.servers.<name>.url at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ instead of the real address.

upstreamUrl.description: network only: the real server's URL.

header.description: network only: header name to inject the resolved credential into, e.g. Authorization.

prefix.description: network only: optional literal prefix prepended to the resolved credential, e.g. "Bearer ".

command.description: local-program only: the real command to run, e.g. "npx".

args.description: local-program only: arguments for the real command.

envVar.description: local-program only: environment variable name the real program expects the credential in.

cwd.description: local-program only: working directory for the spawned program.

passthroughEnv.description: local-program only: extra environment variable names to pass through to the spawned program verbatim, beyond the minimal default set (PATH, HOME, LANG, TMPDIR). The program does not inherit the rest of OpenClaw's own environment.

env.description: local-program only: extra static (non-secret) environment variables the real program needs, e.g. a base URL. Not resolved as a secret input — plain literal values.

servers.label: Protected MCP servers
servers.help: Each entry stands in for one mcp.servers.<name> entry, resolving its credential from OpenClaw's own secret store instead of storing it in mcp.servers directly.
